What is Big Daddy Casino?

Big Daddy Casino is Asia's largest floating casino located on the Mandovi River in Panjim, Goa. It offers a wide range of casino games like Roulette, Poker, Blackjack, and Andar Bahar, along with live entertainment, luxury dining, and VIP services.

What are the entry requirements for Big Daddy Casino?

To enter Big Daddy Casino, visitors must be at least 21 years old and must carry a valid government-issued ID for verification. The casino also follows a smart casual dress code, so be sure to dress accordingly.

How can I reach Big Daddy Casino?

Big Daddy Casino is located in Panjim, and you can reach the Panjim jetty by car, taxi, or bus. From there, a feeder boat will take you to the floating casino. The boat ride is part of the experience.

What is the entry fee for Big Daddy Casino?

The entry fee at Big Daddy Casino varies depending on the package chosen. Regular entry packages start from ₹3,500 per person, while premium packages can go up to ₹6,000 or more per person. Packages include gaming credits, food, and drinks.

What games are available at Big Daddy Casino?

Big Daddy Casino offers a variety of games including Roulette, Poker, Blackjack, Andar Bahar, Teen Patti, and Baccarat. It also has several slot machines and digital gaming options for guests.

Is Big Daddy Casino open 24 hours?

Yes, Big Daddy Casino is open 24/7, allowing guests to enjoy non-stop entertainment and gaming. However, the feeder boats to the casino are available during specific hours, so it’s recommended to check the schedule before planning your visit.

Can I visit Big Daddy Casino with my family?

Yes, you can visit Big Daddy Casino with your family. The casino also offers non-gaming entertainment areas where you can enjoy performances, food, and beverages. However, only guests 21 years and older are allowed on the gaming floor.

Does Big Daddy Casino offer VIP services?

Yes, Big Daddy Casino offers VIP packages with exclusive access to premium areas, imported drinks, and higher-value gaming chips. The VIP experience also includes personalized service and enhanced entertainment options.

What is the dress code at Big Daddy Casino?

The dress code at Big Daddy Casino is smart casual. Guests are expected to wear full-length trousers, shirts with sleeves, and closed shoes. Avoid wearing shorts, flip-flops, or sleeveless t-shirts.

Are there any nearby attractions to Big Daddy Casino?

Yes, Big Daddy Casino is close to several popular attractions in Panjim, including Miramar Beach, Dona Paula Viewpoint, Basilica of Bom Jesus, and Se Cathedral. These can be explored before or after your visit to the casino.

accordion_sections.title: What is Big Daddy Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Big Daddy Casino is Asia's largest floating casino located on the Mandovi River in Panjim, Goa. It offers a wide range of casino games like Roulette, Poker, Blackjack, and Andar Bahar, along with live entertainment, luxury dining, and VIP services.

accordion_sections.title: What are the entry requirements for Big Daddy Casino?
accordion_sections.content: To enter Big Daddy Casino, visitors must be at least 21 years old and must carry a valid government-issued ID for verification. The casino also follows a smart casual dress code, so be sure to dress accordingly.

accordion_sections.title: How can I reach Big Daddy Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Big Daddy Casino is located in Panjim, and you can reach the Panjim jetty by car, taxi, or bus. From there, a feeder boat will take you to the floating casino. The boat ride is part of the experience.

accordion_sections.title: What is the entry fee for Big Daddy Casino?
accordion_sections.content: The entry fee at Big Daddy Casino varies depending on the package chosen. Regular entry packages start from ₹3,500 per person, while premium packages can go up to ₹6,000 or more per person. Packages include gaming credits, food, and drinks.

accordion_sections.title: What games are available at Big Daddy Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Big Daddy Casino offers a variety of games including Roulette, Poker, Blackjack, Andar Bahar, Teen Patti, and Baccarat. It also has several slot machines and digital gaming options for guests.

accordion_sections.title: Is Big Daddy Casino open 24 hours?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Big Daddy Casino is open 24/7, allowing guests to enjoy non-stop entertainment and gaming. However, the feeder boats to the casino are available during specific hours, so it’s recommended to check the schedule before planning your visit.

accordion_sections.title: Can I visit Big Daddy Casino with my family?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, you can visit Big Daddy Casino with your family. The casino also offers non-gaming entertainment areas where you can enjoy performances, food, and beverages. However, only guests 21 years and older are allowed on the gaming floor.

accordion_sections.title: Does Big Daddy Casino offer VIP services?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Big Daddy Casino offers VIP packages with exclusive access to premium areas, imported drinks, and higher-value gaming chips. The VIP experience also includes personalized service and enhanced entertainment options.

accordion_sections.title: What is the dress code at Big Daddy Casino?
accordion_sections.content: The dress code at Big Daddy Casino is smart casual. Guests are expected to wear full-length trousers, shirts with sleeves, and closed shoes. Avoid wearing shorts, flip-flops, or sleeveless t-shirts.

accordion_sections.title: Are there any nearby attractions to Big Daddy Casino?
accordion_sections.content: Yes, Big Daddy Casino is close to several popular attractions in Panjim, including Miramar Beach, Dona Paula Viewpoint, Basilica of Bom Jesus, and Se Cathedral. These can be explored before or after your visit to the casino.
